title: Kenya Couple Safari
headline: Nairobi, then two camps and the Mara at first light.
description: Six nights for two: a night in Nairobi, then safari lodges with game drives timed to the light, not a coach list.
image_alt: African elephants walking across open savanna
price_label: Quoted for your camps and season
price_guidance: Kenya safari pricing depends on camp category, season — migration months command more — and whether you fly or drive to the Mara. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s first Kenya: one Nairobi night to recover from the flight, then a Mara lodge or tented camp with morning and afternoon drives. Built for two, with dietary needs sent to camp before you land.
highlights: Five nights in the Mara as quoted — one camp or a split stay.
Shared or private game drives as the camp operates them.
Optional balloon morning if you add it.
why: Safari time, not a multi-park dash.
Vegetarian camp meals can be arranged when the lodge can do them.
eTA guidance for Indian passports, timed to your tickets.
inclusions: Airport and lodge transfers as quoted — road or scheduled bush flight
Meals at the safari camp as the plan includes them
Game drives as specified in your quote
exclusions: Park fees if they are not itemised in the quote
Balloon safari, spa and drinks unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected Nairobi hotel and Mara lodge or tented camp
stay.room: Double tent or room; private conservancy camps on request
amenities: Wi-Fi where the camp offers it

notes: Camp, vehicle type and park fees are confirmed only after you approve the written quote. Wildlife sightings are never guaranteed. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: A Nairobi night plus a Mara stay. Amboseli or a second park can replace some Mara nights if you prefer.
